paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Batra 86a; he posed a difficulty to Ravina.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has untitled Huna son of Mar Zutra. The notice says he posed a difficulty to Ravina at Bava Batra פו. (86a by convention); no named edition was verified.
